title: oenothera stenomeres f. typica
intro: Oenothera stenomeres f. typica, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant belonging to the Onagraceae family. It is known for its edible flowers and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The plant is rich in omega-6 fatty acids, particularly gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), and has been associated with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera stenomeres f. typica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
